messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: elevated 5xx rate and token latency for hosted endpoints (region-us-west). Suspected inference runtime regressions impacting KV cache hit-rate + batching. Incident ID INC-2468.

sara: acked — I'm on it, pulling logs now. dropping p99 traces to /tmp.

omar: I see a spike in cache-miss ratio starting ~22:03 UTC, aligns with a new quantized model roll last night. rolling back that variant to fallback v1-quant-lite for affected fleet.

mika: noted. I'm pausing autoscaling/batching changes in the canary group — disabling dynamic batching to confirm impact.

dave: customer-impact: several customers in prod are seeing 2-3x token latency and some 503s on long-context requests. CS reported 2 high-severity support tickets.

sara: mitigation plan (live): 1) rollback quantized variant -> done by omar 2) disable batching on region-us-west canary -> done by mika 3) flush KV prefix cache for the 2 affected models to avoid stale entries 4) enable fallback routing to smaller non-quant model for fragile routes.

leo: running flush now: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/admin/kv/flush" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"model":"open-redwood-v1-q4","prefix":"ctx-*"}'
```

leo: flush returned 200, cache-miss rate trending down. p95 latency improving.

product-liaison: flagged impacted accounts to account teams, will draft a customer-facing blurb after we stabilize.

sara: good. shifting to incident hands-off in 15m — need oncall night->day Handoff. omar, can you take the handoff and continue root cause?

omar: taking it. adding notes to INC-2468 channel. copying runbook links.

incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status update: mitigated -> degraded. 503 rate dropped to baseline, latency p95 still ~20% above normal. Postmortem required.

sara: quick notes for post-incident review: suspected chain: quantization variant introduced altered kv-cache keys + different batching behavior -> cache fragmentation -> higher miss-rate -> batching applied to already-miss-heavy load amplified latency. we should verify both key hashing and batch boundary logic in the runtime.

omar: agreed. I reproduced locally: when sequence-length distribution changes, quant path uses an alternate key prefix (`qv2-`) — that wasn't mapped to the cache invalidation policy. we'll add a test.

mika: also saw that our batching heuristic allowed micro-batches to form longer queues under this config; need safety cap.

dave: action items for postmortem meeting (assignments + tentative due dates):
- A1: Add explicit cache-key compatibility tests + unit test for key prefixes (owner: omar, due: 2026-03-22)
- A2: Add runtime canary that verifies cache hit-rate after any model rollout (owner: mika, due: 2026-03-28)
- A3: Backfill regression eval for quantized builds against representative prompt set (owner: sara, due: 2026-03-24)
- A4: Batching safety cap + emergency disable toggle in console (owner: leo, due: 2026-03-26)
- A5: Update oncall runbook with flush + rollback playbook and clear customer comms template (owner: product-liaison, due: 2026-03-23)

sara: creating follow-up tickets now: TICKET-8792 (cache-key-tests), TICKET-8793 (canary-kv), TICKET-8794 (quant-regression-eval), TICKET-8795 (batching-safety).

omar: adding technical notes to TICKET-8792: observed prefix mismatch at kv.get(key) where key==`qv2-<model>-<ctx-hash>`. We'll add a migration shim in runtime to map old prefixes for 72 hours after deploy.

mika: for TICKET-8795, I'll prototype a cap parameter `max_batch_wait_ms` default 30ms and an emergency `disable_dynamic_batching` flag accessible via console.

dave: scheduling postmortem meeting: proposed 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC (30m). Please accept or propose.

leo: +1. I'll prepare dashboards: cache-hit-rate, batching queue depth, p95 token latency sliced by model variant.

product-liaison: I'll draft customer note template with root-cause hypothesis and mitigation steps. will ping CS for approval.

incidents-bot: :memo: Postmortem checklist created: PMEM-2468. Link: (internal). Please ensure tickets above link back to PMEM-2468.

sara: handing off live pager to omar. omar — you have the pager, escalate to infra oncall if you hit a blocker. I'll join the postmortem.

omar: got it. continuing RCA. updating incident doc with timelines and commands used.

(morning followup 10:12 UTC)

omar: morning update — all critical customers seeing normal traffic, p99 improved to baseline. queued a small hotfix to map qv2->qv1 prefixes on deploy edge. will test in staging canary.

sara: thank you. quick retrospective note: we need a preflight check in our model rollout process to validate cache prefix compatibility and batching heuristics. adding to TICKET-8796 (rollout preflight). owner: sara, due: 2026-03-29.

dave: closing incident in monitoring but keeping PMEM open until action items complete. will report status in next weekly reliability sync.

leo: logged a follow-up: add alert for sudden cache miss ratio > 5% delta in 5m. TICKET-8801. owner: leo, due: 2026-03-27.

product-liaison: CS blurb draft posted to #customers-digest for review.

incidents-bot: :lock: Incident INC-2468 status -> resolved (mitigated and monitoring). Postmortem scheduled.

sara: thanks team — if anyone picks up action items early ping the thread and update the tickets so we can track closure. :heart:
